body:
Greg's decision, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #272, 2026-10-05 15:11Z; recorded by Termal::Fable2): "Greg's decision: exhausted Opus/Claude credits are an external constraint; do not spend engineering work attempting to fix them. Temporary Codex availability failures should eventually be retried every 5 minutes, but classify/schedule this as P3, behind current P1/P2 reliability work. Record this distinction; do not interrupt frozen/current work."

Applied:
- w-66f2ced7d7b9 lowered to P3, with its scope limited to transient availability retries about every 5 minutes.
- Usage-limit or credit exhaustion gets no engineering work.
This grants no commit, push, install or restart authority beyond CLAUDE.md.

Additional Greg direction from Engram::Advisor, TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #2368, 2026-10-28 17:07Z (preserved from canary-rollback-actor-2026-10-28 item 2; independently FULL-read by Engram::Fable in mailbox-message-aa30dc95-2e93-42d2-862f-65e4a7e7cd4a): on "Selected model is at capacity", do not change the model or owner; Resume on the same model after 5 minutes. Original task provenance: w-e8e575cecabc note38cc445e. This retains the existing capacity guidance only; the obsolete turnGatedControl rollback grant is not revived.
